(Japanese: '''オリバ''' ''Oriba'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG176|The Ole' Berate and Switch!]]''.

Oriba and his {{p|Marowak}} competed against {{Ash}} and {{AP|Corphish}} in a Pokémon tournament in [[Sable City]]. After blocking several attacks, Marowak was eventually defeated by the {{type|Water}} Pokémon.
